scope: Primary-source research context; these engineered models are not identified cortical circuits.

sources.title: Chaos in Random Neural Networks
sources.read: Primary abstract; theoretical stationary/chaotic transition in large random rate networks
sources.limit: Not empirical cortex identification; finite driven heterogeneous noisy generator is different

sources.title: Linking Connectivity, Dynamics, and Computations in Low-Rank Recurrent Neural Networks
sources.read: Primary full paper: model equations1/2/5, phase diagram, structured versus random dynamics; published PDF supplement rank-two oscillations
sources.finding: Random connectivity + low-rank component supports structured states and rich dynamics; rank-two motifs can support oscillations
sources.limit: Theoretical model and designed computations, not proof that speech cortex has this exact connectivity; canonical current equation differs from our rate-style equation

sources.title: Neural ensemble dynamics in dorsal motor cortex during speech in people with paralysis
sources.read: Primary PubMed abstract/figure captions and indexed primary discussion; direct full eLife/PMC fetch challenged
sources.finding: Two intracortical hand-knob participants; onset transient both, reported speech rotations in better-modulated participant
sources.limit: Not ventral speech uECoG; small cohort, task/region dependence

sources.title: Latent neural dynamics encode temporal context in speech
sources.read: Primary full text theory/methods jPCA and discussion caveat; author manuscript indexed passage
sources.finding: ECoG STG listening, reduced-rank feature-response latents, onset/peak-rate context and cyclic geometry
sources.limit: Authors explicitly discuss horseshoe effect/overlapping evoked responses; not intended to distinguish dynamical versus representational coding

sources.title: Shared latent representations of speech production for cross-patient speech decoding
sources.read: Local primary full text tmp/pdfs/uecog-papers-2026-09-30/paper2026-raw.txt introduction/method overview and surrogate scope; PubMed primary page
sources.finding: Eight speech uECoG patients; PCA latents/CCA alignment, shared speech-related structure
sources.limit: Does not identify a governing ODE or prove chaos

sources.title: Theta and Alpha Oscillations Are Traveling Waves in the Human Neocortex
sources.read: Author-hosted primary indexed introduction/summary/model relation; direct web open502
sources.finding: ECoG memory task,2-15Hz waves, coupled oscillator/frequency-gradient explanation
sources.limit: Low-frequency phase waves, not HGA amplitude waves; our magnitude frontend does not retain raw oscillatory phase

sources.title: Inferring collective dynamical states from widely unobserved systems
sources.finding: Selected rat hippocampal/cat visual/monkey prefrontal recordings consistent with fading reverberation, not exactly critical
sources.limit: PAR assumptions and applicability tests; not universal law of human speech cortex

sources.title: Different Origins of Gamma Rhythm and High-Gamma Activity in Macaque Visual Cortex
sources.read: Primary full text abstract/results stimulus manipulation and firing/power relation
sources.finding: Dissociation gamma rhythm versus broadband high gamma; high gamma correlated with local multiunit firing
sources.limit: Microelectrode macaque V1; not complete generative observation law for human uECoG

sources.title: Turbulent-like Dynamics in the Human Brain
sources.read: Primary indexed methods/results and study abstract; direct subsequent opens challenged
sources.finding: Stuart-Landau/Hopf whole-brain model and1003participant resting/task fMRI spatial statistics
sources.limit: fMRI0.008-0.08Hz; no direct HGA timescale or causal mechanism identification

sources.title: A neural architecture for imagined and overt speech motor dynamics
sources.read: Primary full text methods, results, limitations; publishedSep29
sources.finding: Nine high-density ECoG participants; articulatory encoding and beta/high-gamma modality differences
sources.limit: Linear temporal response models/lead-lag correlations; not identification of autonomous vector field, task restricted

sources.title: Inferring Latent Dynamics Underlying Neural Population Activity via Neural Differential Equations
sources.finding: Latent nonlinear ODE inference with Poisson observation; synthetic attractors and rat decision task
sources.limit: Learned latent-coordinate models do not identify unique biological equations

sources.title: Optimal control of transient dynamics in balanced networks supports generation of complex movements
sources.read: Primary author PDF: abstract/introduction, equations and stability optimization, transient amplification, motor comparison, initial-state dependence; re-read October18
sources.finding: Optimized inhibitory structure stabilizes strong excitation while allowing large patterned transients; nonchaotic mechanism can account for selected monkey reaching population features.
sources.limit: Optimized E/I network, selected preparation states and input weights; not a random low-rank replication or direct speech uECoG model.

sources.title: Balanced amplification: a new mechanism of selective amplification of neural activity patterns
sources.read: Primary PDF opened; abstract/indexed primary account reviewed. PDF text extraction sparse; not claiming full derivation checked.
sources.finding: Pattern-selective amplification need not require prolonging the response lifetime.
sources.limit: Theory of cortical network amplification; not empirical identification of speech HGA.

sources.title: Macroscopic Description for Networks of Spiking Neurons
sources.read: Primary full PDF model, Lorentzian ansatz, macroscopic equations, assumptions and generalization; re-read October18
sources.finding: Exact macroscopic reduction in thermodynamic limit for specified QIF networks; firing rate and mean voltage can support synchronization and bursting.
sources.limit: All-to-all connectivity, quenched heterogeneity, Lorentzian distribution for the simple two-equation form; not a universally exact cortical generator.

sources.title: Single-trial neural dynamics are dominated by richly varied movements
sources.read: Primary PubMed abstract/figure captions and indexed primary results, rechecked October18; PMID31551604, DOI10.1038/s41593-019-0502-4.
sources.finding: Movement-related and uninstructed behavioral variability contributes substantially to measured neural activity in the studied mouse tasks.
sources.limit: Mouse recordings and particular behavioral tasks; not direct evidence for a particular human speech generator or autonomous dynamics.

sources.title: Residual dynamics resolves recurrent contributions to neural computation
sources.read: Primary accepted manuscript downloaded from UCL; introduction, equation1, constructed trajectory counterexamples, residual local/global distinction, multi-area simulations, methods2SLS assumptions; not claiming entire supplement read.
sources.finding: Different recurrent/input mechanisms can have identical condition means in the constructed examples. Residual dynamics can reveal functional recurrent contributions under assumptions, but correlated upstream input complicates localization.
sources.limit: MacaquePFC decision/saccade data. Estimator assumes Markov state and temporally uncorrelated observation noise; overlapping STFT magnitudes do not automatically satisfy this. Local residuals do not uniquely identify local circuitry.
